decisions.reason: A rye country bread is a core everyday staple of a traditional German bakery, so it is cheap to keep and likely to sell steadily.
The award-winning flagship premium stollen drives seasonal revenue and the firm's reputation.
The dark malt rye bread is a niche variety and the most exposed to further range pruning after Product C was dropped, but it fits the traditional bread range at low cost.
The marzipan stollen is a classic gift and seasonal item that complements the flagship stollen line.
The ancient grain 'Meisterstück' is actively promoted and fits the health and heritage-grain trend.
